info.name: CleanedWeb API
info.description:
Maintained REST APIs that return structured records from public websites: job boards, marketplaces, app stores, package registries, research databases and more. Each API in the catalog has a fixed input contract and output schema, and CleanedWeb keeps it working when the site changes.

## Get started
1. **Find an API** (no key needed): run *List catalog APIs* with `q` set to a site or topic, then *Get an endpoint's contract* to see its inputs and record fields.
2. **Get a key**: create an account at [cleanedweb.com](https://cleanedweb.com/?utm_source=postman&utm_medium=public-workspace) and an API key with the `run` scope under API keys. Paste it into the `api_key` collection variable (keep it as a secret; current value only).
3. **Run it**: *Run an endpoint* or one of the ready examples. Start with a small `max_items`. A run that takes longer than `wait_seconds` answers 202; read *Read a run's result* with the same `Idempotency-Key` (the collection sets one per run).

Pricing is per accepted record: see [pricing](https://cleanedweb.com/pricing/?utm_source=postman&utm_medium=public-workspace). Missing a site? Ask for it from its [catalog page](https://cleanedweb.com/catalog/?utm_source=postman&utm_medium=public-workspace).

Docs: [cleanedweb.com/docs](https://cleanedweb.com/docs/?utm_source=postman&utm_medium=public-workspace) · OpenAPI: https://cleanedweb.com/catalog/openapi.json · MCP server for AI agents: `https://api.cleanedweb.com/mcp?profile=catalog` ([setup](https://cleanedweb.com/docs/mcp/?utm_source=postman&utm_medium=public-workspace))

item.description: Reading the catalog needs no credential.

request.description: Search the published APIs. `q` matches site, name and description; page with `limit` and `offset`; `sort` is `updated` or `name`.
One API: site, endpoints, versions, health and 30-day reliability.
The endpoint's `input_schema` (what you can send in `input`) and `output_schema` (the fields of each record).

item.name: 2. Run an API
item.description: Needs an API key with the `run` scope. Runs use the workspace's credits.

exec: // One Idempotency-Key per run. Read /result with the same key; send the POST again only with a new key.

request.description: Runs the endpoint's latest major (pin one with `"version": N`). `input` takes the fields of the contract's `input_schema`; unknown fields are rejected. `max_items` stops after that many de-duplicated records. 200 carries `records`; 202 means still running: read the result with the same Idempotency-Key.
Same API key and same Idempotency-Key as the run. Reading never collects the website again.
